errorCodes.cause: Hardware overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power switch, restart after 30 seconds. If still not working, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Under-voltage — input supply voltage is too low (below 176V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power and check input supply voltage. If voltage is low, restart after voltage returns to normal. If voltage is normal but controller still fails, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Over-voltage when machine is off — input voltage too high (above 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power and check input voltage. If above 264V, restart after voltage normalizes. If voltage is normal but problem persists, replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Over-voltage in operation — input voltage too high (above 264V) while sewing
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power, check input voltage. If above 264V, restart after normalizing. Replace controller if problem persists.

errorCodes.cause: Solenoid circuit fault — solenoid connection loose or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system. Check carefully if solenoid connection is loose or damaged; replace if so. Restart. If still not working, inform manufacturer and replace controller.

errorCodes.cause: Motor current measuring failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power, restart after 30 seconds. If fault occurs frequently, seek technical support.

errorCodes.cause: Sewing motor blocked — motor input plug off, loose, or broken; or foreign body tangled in machine head
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system. Check motor input plug condition. Check machine head for tangles. Re-make correct then restart. Replace controller if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Communication failure between control panel and controller
errorCodes.solution: Check that connection between control panel and controller is not loose or broken. Correct then restart. Replace controller if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Machine head needle positioning failure — synchronizer connection loose or not restored
errorCodes.solution: Check connection line between machine head synchronizer and controller. Restore it and restart. Replace controller and inform manufacturer if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Initial motor electrical angle failure
errorCodes.solution: Try 2 to 3 more times after power down. If still failing, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor HALL failure — motor sensor plug loose or dropped off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system. Check if motor sensor plug is loose or dropped off; restore and restart. If still failing, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: DSP Read/Write EEPROM failure
errorCodes.solution: Contact manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor over-speed protection
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system, restart after 30 seconds. If still not working, replace controller and inform manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Motor reversion
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system, restart after 30 seconds. Replace controller if persistent.

errorCodes.cause: HMI Read/Write EEPROM failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system, restart after 30 seconds. Replace controller if persistent.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overload — motor may be stalled
errorCodes.solution: Check if motor is stalled. If not stalled, replace controller and notify manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Oil shortage alarm — oil quantity has fallen below normal level
errorCodes.solution: System detects oil quantity below normal level, exceeded set time. Add oil to machine.

errorCodes.cause: Motor blocked encoder failure — motor input plug off, loose, or broken; foreign body tangled in machine head
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system. Check motor input plug and machine head for tangles. Correct then restart. Replace controller if still failing.

errorCodes.cause: Bobbin detection alarm — bobbin insufficient or sensor issue
errorCodes.solution: Check if bobbin is sufficient. If bobbin is sufficient but error still exists, replace controller and notify manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Thread end detection alarm — thread end not cleared
errorCodes.solution: Restart after clearing the thread end. If still fails to work properly, replace controller and notify manufacturer.

errorCodes.cause: Password lock shutdown alarm — machine use time limit has been reached
errorCodes.solution: If continued use is required, please contact your local service provider.

alarmCodes.cause: Stitch counter alarm — stitch counter has reached the limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press P key to cancel the alarm and reset the counter.

alarmCodes.cause: Trimming counter alarm — trimming counter has reached the limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press P key to cancel the alarm and reset the counter.
Please wait for 30 seconds, then turn on the power switch.

alarmCodes.cause: Safety switch alarm — machine is not in correct position
alarmCodes.solution: Adjust the machine to the correct position.

parameters.name: Run up to needle position after power on

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine shows error code on startup
checks: Confirm machine connection cable is intact
Confirm electronic control box and machine head are matched

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine will not start after showing Err-08
checks: Check motor input plug is not off, loose, or broken
Check if something is tangled around the machine head
Check input supply voltage at socket
Restart controller after voltage returns to normal
Replace controller if voltage is normal but error persists
This is a normal counter full notification
Press P key to cancel alarm and reset counter
